chapter: Childhood and first bands in Ohio
title: Buckeye Melodians and drummer Gerald Hobson
summary: His first band was the Buckeye Melodians at home; later Earl Warren's father took it over, and Gerald Hobson encouraged him with stories of New York.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: A little band at home called the Buckeye Melodians.
Uh-huh. Who was the leader? Was that Wesley Helvey's band there?
No, no, no, that came later.
Yeah, that came to Springfield, Ohio.
Later on Earl Warren, you know, the saxophone player, his father later took it over after I left home. And Earl was just starting to play at that time, just starting to learn to play saxophone.
So there was a drummer, Gerald Hobson. Gerald Hobson used to come and play with our band. He lived in New York a long time and I used to like to listen to him telling me stories of New York.
